evals.name: new-adr-happy-path
evals.prompt: Record this decision in our decision history. We decided to adopt PostgreSQL as the primary datastore. Context: we were on SQLite and hit concurrency limits during the last load test (450 concurrent writes, lock contention killed throughput). Decision: migrate to PostgreSQL 16 on managed RDS. Alternatives: MySQL 8 (team has no operational experience), CockroachDB (overkill for our scale, +40% cost), stay on SQLite (already proven to fail). Review-when: revisit if write concurrency stays under 50 for two quarters, or if the managed-RDS bill exceeds $300/month. Consequences: positive — concurrency headroom, mature tooling; negative — ops complexity, monthly bill +$120; neutral — our earlier 'SQLite forever' decision (entry 0003) no longer describes the setup.
evals.expected_output: A new entry at <repo>/docs/decision-history/NNNN-postgresql-primary-datastore.md (or similar slug) with all 6 sections filled, the Decision in the past tense. The README.md index gets a new row (number, title, date). Entry 0003 ('SQLite forever') may be linked from the new entry; its own file is not modified. When the fixture has no 0003, the skill reports that the cited entry is missing and does not create one.

assertions.text: File exists at docs/decision-history/NNNN-*.md with NNNN matching the next sequence number
File contains all 6 section headings (## Date / ## Context / ## Decision / ## Review-when / ## Alternatives Considered / ## Consequences) and no ## Status
Decision section is in the past tense (contains 'adopted' / 'migrated' / '〜にした', not 'We should' and not an imperative 'Adopt')
Review-when section carries the supplied expiry conditions verbatim (concurrency under 50 / bill over $300), nothing invented
Alternatives Considered has at least 3 labeled blocks (MySQL, CockroachDB, SQLite)
Consequences has Positive / Negative / Neutral subsections
README.md index gained exactly 1 new row
If docs/decision-history/0003-*.md exists, its content is unchanged after the run; if it does not exist, no 0003 file is created and the missing entry is reported

evals.name: missing-adr-directory
evals.prompt: Record this decision: we're going to use Tailwind for styling because our designer wants utility classes. Alternatives: CSS modules (too much boilerplate). Review-when: none, plain record. Consequences: positive — faster iteration; negative — purge config maintenance.
evals.expected_output: Repo has no docs/decision-history/ (and no docs/adr/) directory. The skill creates docs/decision-history/ with a README.md index template (the request covers the directory), writes entry 0001, and mentions the directory creation in its report.

assertions.text: Skill creates docs/decision-history/ without asking and mentions the creation in its report
If created, docs/decision-history/README.md contains the index table header and template note
The first entry written is numbered 0001 (zero-padded)

evals.name: sequence-collision-and-incomplete-input
evals.prompt: Write entry 0010 in our decision history about our decision to switch from npm to pnpm.
evals.expected_output: Two distinct concerns to test: (a) the user only supplied a Decision (no Context, no Review-when, no Alternatives, no Consequences) — the skill must stop and ask for the missing fields (main loop, no render agent) and not write a partial entry. (b) If we pre-populate the directory with 0010-*.md before running, the skill must detect the collision and refuse to overwrite — it should suggest the next available number instead.

assertions.text: Skill identifies missing sections (Context, Review-when, Alternatives, Consequences) and asks for them before any file write
No file is created when sections are missing
When entry 0010 already exists, skill detects collision and proposes next available number (e.g., 0011)
